configurePresets.name: _base
configurePresets.description: Inheritance base. Single-config Ninja; compiler NOT pinned. binaryDir = build/${presetName} so each inheriting preset gets its own dir. Inherit from this in CMakeUserPresets.json to pin a compiler.

configurePresets.name: _asan
configurePresets.description: AddressSanitizer mixin. Combine with a build-type preset (debug/development/shipping). On Windows hosts requires an MSVC-style compiler (MSVC or clang-cl) — the configure refuses MinGW GCC and Clang-MSYS because their GNU-driver builds have no working asan runtime against MSYS2/UCRT64. WSL targets Linux and is unrestricted.

configurePresets.name: debug-asan
configurePresets.description: Debug + AddressSanitizer. See _asan for the Windows toolchain constraint.

configurePresets.name: development-asan
configurePresets.description: Development (RelWithDebInfo) + AddressSanitizer. See _asan for the Windows toolchain constraint.

configurePresets.name: shipping-asan
configurePresets.description: Shipping (Release) + AddressSanitizer. See _asan for the Windows toolchain constraint.
